text:
elaine: FYI CI is failing on docs PR #472 — linkcheck step errors out for /guides/runtime.md, anchor '#runtime-config' not found
chris: ugh, ok. that's the file we migrated from mkdocs last week
elaine: yeah, I think the heading had an emoji and a thin space that mkdocs slugified differently
maria: can you paste the failing log? @doc-ci-bot any more details?
doc-ci-bot: linkcheck: Failed to resolve fragment '#runtime-config' in /guides/runtime.md at line 142
chris: looks like the heading is "Runtime configuration ⚙️" — docusaurus didn't drop the emoji from the slug
dan: quick fix: add an explicit id to the heading: `### Runtime configuration {#runtime-config}`
elaine: will that play nicely with both mkdocs-derived files and docusaurus?
chris: yeah docusaurus/mdx respects explicit header IDs
maria: alternative is to normalize slugs in the linkcheck step, but that's more invasive
elaine: I pushed a small PR with the explicit id, also stripped a soft-hyphen in the line that had `­` (weird invisible char)
dan: nice — can you include the snippet you used?
elaine: sure: ```md
- Before:
### Runtime configuration ⚙️
- After:
### Runtime configuration {#runtime-config}
``` 
chris: thanks. also add a changelog note to the migration guide mentioning we added IDs for stable anchors
maria: logging: when CI reruns, if still fails we should add a fallback in our linkcheck (ignore fragments for those migrated pages)
elaine: CI rerun queued :thumbsup:
doc-ci-bot: Re-run started for PR #472
chris: if rerun passes we should audit other migrated guides for emoji/nbsp issues — maybe a single grep for ` |⚙️|‍` in docs folder
dan: I can run a quick scan and open follow-up PRs for any hits
maria: +1, let's target small, atomic fixes rather than broad auto-rewrites
elaine: rerun finished ✅ — linkcheck now passes
chris: awesome, thanks for the quick turnaround
elaine: I'll merge the PR and add a one-liner to the docs migration checklist: "add explicit header ids for headings with emoji or non-ascii chars"
maria: perfect. closing thread, but @dan please create the scan PR when you have a minute
dan: on it, ETA today
elaine: thanks all :coffee:
